lines.en: SO DRAW ME IN TO INTO YOU.
: Touka?...
: Will you...talk to me now?
: Please?
These words, that once would have cut like a knife, had dulled and pressed upon the skin of Touka Tsukioka hard enough to bruise her.

The secrets that spilled all over the cell the night Yasu was claimed clung to her when she returned home shortly after. And it took little more than a glance to expose them for what they really were.
Misguided betrayal. Reckless naiveté. Orbs of repressed vitriol that hovered over two separate souls like halos, incessantly reminding her of the chaos that exists outside of her bubble.
Silence was easier than anger, though.
So Touka had her own share of secrets now. Or at least little thoughts she could fashion into them to distract her from the jagged, whispery voice pouring from an angel’s cocoon.
If only metamorphosis came easy. Then each of them could fly away.
: Touka-
: Did I not tell you to leave me alone, Yasu? Go have fun with the other girls. I will not be your babysitter this weekend.
: But I don’t want to be with the other girls right now. And you’ve barely said anything to me all week.
: Can we at least swim in the same water?
: I am in no mood to swim, Yasu.
: You’re in no mood to do anything. All you do now is just sit around and look angry. And your blood is so loud I’m afraid it will rip you in two.
: Then you best close the door behind you so you’re not covered in it when I do explode. Bye-bye now.
: No! Stop doing that! It’s not fair if I’m the only one ever being looked out for!

: Through His teachings, I have learned that in times of crisis, even the most lost of lambs can still find their way back. And I know it is not a fitting role, but I would like to play the shepherd this time so you can-
: I don’t care about your stupid god. I don’t care about what you think he teaches you. And I definitely don’t care to have you of all people try to reach out and help me right now.
: Touka! That’s-
: I am trying to do the right thing and not talk rudely to you as I know this is not entirely your fault...
: But unfortunately, that means I must not talk to you at all for a little while because my self-control only goes so far.
: Now, close the door and go. Surely there’s someone else for you to share the water with.
: I don’t want to share it with anyone else, though. The two of us almost always enjoy the beach trip together. Why would it be any different this time?
: Why would it- are you fucking kidding me right now?
: Please don’t curse. You of all people shouldn’t dirty yourself with such little sins.

: Fuck your “sins” and fuck your idea of what is “clean” and fuck your fucking outlook on fucking curse words! I’m telling you one last time to leave me alone! I do not want to be around you, Yasu. At all.
: What happened to make you act this way toward me?...
: Oh, stop pretending to be an idiot. Surely you’re competent enough to know when and how all of this started.
: Is everything okay, you two? Should Molly and I step out?
: Yes, please. And take Yasu with you so I can call the front desk and ask them how much longer it will be until my room is ready.
: I brought a bunch of new manga, Yasu. I even separated them based on how sinful they are so you can pick and choose from what I will now refer to as the “purity pile.”
: That is very thoughtful and it sounds very fun, but I need to talk to Touka and I can’t figure out how to do it without making her angrier.
: A good start would have been attempting to do so without spectators. Just as a reference point in the future.
: I did try that! Over and over and over again! But you’re just as cold when I do that as you are right now! And you’re the type of girl who normally burns like the sun!
: If something is wrong, Touka, you must tell me! Lest your essence be corrupted and send you spiraling halfway down the-
: Can you stop playing dumb and speak to me like a normal fucking girl if you want to talk?!

: In fact, what good do you think talking is even going to do when all of my words will be inevitably filtered through some fucking ancient codex anyway?! You don’t actually hear me! You don’t listen!
: You sit there every fucking day, wide-eyed and aloof! Often in the wrong direction! And all I say goes in one ear and out the other!
: What exists between them, I have no idea! But it clearly isn’t a brain if you can’t even comprehend what “go away” means!
: Why are you being so mean?...
: Hah! Why am I being so- I don’t know, Yasu. I really don’t.
: Perhaps I should strip down and lock myself in a musty jail cell to repent for my actions on my fucking knees since that’s what your religion would likely have me do.
: So...that is what has caused you such great pain then.
: Oh, what a fucking genius you are! Excellent job, Yasu! You finally figured it out!
: Okay, yeah. I think we should probably go.
: Uhh...just come find us in the common room if you want to check out the purity pile, Yasu. I can almost guarantee it isn’t going anywhere.
: Why didn’t you just say something, Touka?! You know our beliefs don’t align! I don’t understand what it is that you’re not okay with when it’s often the complete opposite from what I-
: NO ONE IN THE FUCKING WORLD IS “OKAY” WITH THE THINGS YOU ARE, YASU! JUST FUCKING ADAPT, ALREADY! I DID! DO YOU NOT REMEMBER THAT THIS WORLD IS NEW FOR ME TOO?!
: But you’re strong! And I’m just-
: Does this look like “strong” to you?! Do you think I’m adequately holding things together right now?!
: Or am I perhaps a little pissed off that you’d give away your fucking purity so easily?! Over a fucking nightmare, no less!
: Okay. Time to go, Molly.
: I taught you better than this. Mother and I taught you better than this. But, like always, you heard absolutely fucking nothing.

: Now it’s just like you’re back at the fucking doctor’s office, letting people take advantage of you all over again! If only you listened to those who care about you even half as much as you listen to all those fucking “voices!”
: I had to do it, Touka! You don’t understand! But I’m safe now! And I don’t need to do it anymore! I don’t need to-
: Oh, good! No worries at all then! What great news!
: R...Really? I-
: NO, YOU FUCKING DUNCE! IT’S NOT GREAT! IT WILL NEVER BE GREAT! YOU LOST YOUR VIRGINITY TO A TEACHER IN THE BASEMENT OF A FUCKING CHURCH AFTER LITERALLY BEGGING FOR IT!
: There are over ten thousand fucking religions in this world and not a single ONE OF THEM beside yours would endorse such a thing! Take a fucking second to think about that, Yasu!
: But you want to do the same thing! You want to receive Sensei’s light too! So why is it only bad for me?!
: What would have been the right way to do it in your eyes?! Why haven’t you yelled at anyone else?!
: BECAUSE YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO BE MY BEST FRIEND! Did you really think you could do something like this and I’d just shrug it off like it’s no big deal?! I haven’t even slept with him yet!
: Okay, but I have! And just because we’re friends doesn’t mean you get to tell me what I’m allowed to do with my body! It’s still mine!
: Sensei took very good care of me. And I-
: He took care of you. Oh, great. That’s just great. I absolutely love all of the things that could possibly mean. What a wonderful thing to hear.

: I don’t regret it one bit...I’m safer now. And we aren’t in love, so you don’t need to feel the sort of pressure commonly associated with adultery! You can still sleep with him and I’ll be happy for you!
: Thank you so much for your blessing, Yasu. That means just about as much to me as the ten paragraph passage you spoke at my bedside while I was trying to fall asleep last night.
: Those words mean everything, though! They-
: They mean nothing! NOTHING! Your bible is NOTHING but a mess of nonsensical contradictory statements you pull out to justify everything! But there’s no meaning! It’s all just fanatical drivel!
: It’s not! It’s the truth!
: Then tell me why you said just a moment ago that your body belongs to you when I’ve heard a million times that it belongs to your fucking god! Which one is it, Yasu?!
: It is both.
: Yeah, of fucking course it is. How convenient.
: He gave me this body. And while it is my body to do as I please with, that does not mean I mistrust what He would have me do with it.
: Mhm. And was He also the one who made you strip down for all those little “photo sessions” in the past?
: That was before I knew of Him.
: But if He asked you to do them now, would you?
: Yasu-
: I would.
: I knew it...
: Nothing about you is yours. No girl would choose a place like that for one of the most important moments of her life. You’re just a puppet.
: I’m not a puppet...
: Oh, perhaps just a worm then? A roach? What are all of those other terrible things “He Who Loves You So Much” forces you to call yourself? There are too many to recount right now.
: A maggot, perhaps? A housefly? Oh! Why not go for something truly exotic and call yourself a fucking vinegaroon while you’re at it?!
: Because I’m a girl! I’m not a bug! I’m not a worm! I’m Yasu!

: I like shoujo manga and strawberry daifuku and swimming and you! I like Sensei too! I’m not a puppet! I’m not an idiot! I’m just me! And I can’t help it if I’m a little broken when I was born this way!

: You can’t say that God is leading me astray when you’re doing the same thing He is, though! You both have ideas for what I’m supposed to be and how I’m supposed to act and I can’t follow all of them!
: So what am I supposed to do, Touka?! Trust your word over the one that’s been with me way longer?!
: Believe that you are right and He is wrong and wait until the world is over to do what everyone else is doing?!
: I just want to live! I want to keep experiencing these happy days for the first time in my life!
: And I’m sorry if the choice I made makes you sad or angry, but it was still my choice at the end of the day! And I stand by it!
: You are an idiot, Yasu.
: You don’t even realize it’s worse when the choice is truly yours.
: But...how?
: You tell me. If you’re as human as you say you are, what other reasons might I have to be upset about you and Sensei crossing the line you did?
: It isn’t like that...
: I really just...
: It saved me. He saved me.
: You just keep making it worse, don’t you?
: If it is an apology you want, I will get down on my knees and-
: Yasu, how would you like having the dorm room to yourself for a while?
: ...What?
: Perhaps even indefinitely? I think it’s rather clear that Kumon-mi High isn’t going to work out as well for me as my mother had hoped.
: You’re...leaving?
: I haven’t decided anything yet, but-
: No. No, you can’t leave. Not now. The timing is wrong. Bad things will happen if you leave.
: Yasu-
: I’ll leave. You can stay and I’ll go out on my own again. I’ve done it before. I can survive. I can-
: I’ve had enough of your prophecies, okay? I don’t care how...accurate they are most of the time. My fate is decided by me and me alone. Not the things you hear and not the things you see.
: This is what it means to be free. Not...whatever you are.
: Touka...please...
: Salvation doesn’t seem so great anymore, now does it?
: Please...
: I told you to leave me alone, didn’t I?
: Don’t go...
: My words never mattered to you. It’s exactly as I said.
: In one ear...
: Out the other.
: May your “end of days” be full of bliss.
: And...may the...
: May the path you walk...
: Be free of callousness...
Touka has dropped out!
